review_description: Straight forward quotation process, quick installation and very good customer service.Highly recommend

A clear quotation with detailed price breakdown and design was provided. All my questions and concerns were answered. The installation team were professional and friendly. The installer helped in setting up the online monitoring app. Amazing after sales service. Very happy with our new system.I would really high recommend Photon Energy Solutions to anyone looking for solar installation.
They showed up to do a physical inspection and gave a quote. At installation, they were prompt and tidy.
